MORE:
Pursuant to Clause 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulation, 2015, we state the outcome of the Board Meeting as under: -
1. The meeting of the Board of Directors held today, i.e., on Friday, the 13th November, 2026 commenced at 1.00 p.m. and concluded at 2.00 p.m. 
2. The Board has approved the Un-Audited Financial Results for the Second Quarter and Half year Ended on 30th September 2026 upon the recommendation of the Audit Committee.
Copies of the Un-Audited Financial Results for the Second Quarter and Half year ended 30th September, 2026 together with the Limited Review Report to the un-audited financial result are attached. Please take these documents on your record.
